tasks.build: deno task build:web && deno task build:visualizer
tasks.build:web: cd apps/web && deno run -A npm:vite@^7.0.4 build
tasks.build:visualizer: cd apps/visualizer && deno run -A npm:vite@^7.0.4 build
tasks.check: deno check packages/common/src packages/ui/src packages/websocket/src apps/server/src apps/web/src apps/visualizer/src
tasks.db-generate: cd apps/server && deno run -A npm:prisma@^6.18.0 generate
tasks.dev: deno task dev:prepare:noauth && IGNORE_LOGIN=true VITE_IGNORE_LOGIN=true deno run -A npm:mprocs@^0.9.1 --config mprocs.yaml
tasks.dev:auth: deno task dev:prepare && deno run -A npm:mprocs@^0.9.1 --config mprocs.yaml
tasks.dev:panel:db: cd apps/server && deno run -A npm:prisma@^6.18.0 studio
tasks.dev:server: deno run -A npm:concurrently@^9.2.1 "deno task dev:panel:server" "deno task tsoa:watch" "deno task openapi:watch"
tasks.dev:ui:visualizer: deno task dev:prepare:visualizer && deno run -A npm:mprocs@^0.9.1 --config mprocs.visualizer.yaml
tasks.dev:visualizer: deno run -A npm:concurrently@^9.2.1 "deno task dev:server" "deno task dev:panel:visualizer"
tasks.dev:web: deno run -A npm:concurrently@^9.2.1 "deno task dev:server" "deno task dev:panel:web"
tasks.dev:web:noauth: deno task dev:prepare:noauth && IGNORE_LOGIN=true VITE_IGNORE_LOGIN=true deno task dev:web
tasks.openapi:watch: cd apps/server && deno run -A npm:onchange@^7.1.0 './build/swagger.yaml' -- deno task openapi
tasks.secrets:pull: PROJECT=cmumaps APPS='web server visualizer dataflow' ENVS='applicants local dev staging prod' ./scripts/secrets/multi/pull.sh
tasks.secrets:push: PROJECT=cmumaps APPS='web server visualizer dataflow' ENVS='applicants local dev staging prod' ./scripts/secrets/multi/push.sh
tasks.sync: deno task db-generate && deno task tsoa && deno task openapi
tasks.tsoa: cd apps/server && deno run -A npm:tsoa@^6.6.0 spec-and-routes
tasks.tsoa:watch: cd apps/server && deno run -A npm:onchange@^7.1.0 'src/controllers/*.ts' 'tsoa.json' -- deno task tsoa
